dataset.name: Göteborg congestion tax (trängselskatt)
dataset.method: Lag (2004:629) om trängselskatt, bilaga 2: per passage of a charging station, by time of day; passages within 60 minutes pay once; at most 60 SEK a day; weekdays, not the day before a public holiday nor in July. Foreign-registered vehicles pay too (4 §). Stations: Transportstyrelsen's gantries in OpenStreetMap; the Backa stations (taxed only with a control point within 30 minutes) are left out.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.

coverage.reason: the congestion tax's taxed days (high season, July, holiday eves) are kept as an extension
